sparql: PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?year ?totalPapers ?empiricalPapers ((xsd:decimal(?empiricalPapers) / xsd:decimal(?totalPapers)) AS ?proportionEmpirical) WHERE { { SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?totalPapers) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . } GROUP BY ?year } { SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper2) AS ?empiricalPapers) WHERE { ?paper2 orkgp:P31 ?c2 . ?c2 a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper2 orkgp:P29 ?year . ?c2 orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc rdfs:label ?dcl . ?c2 orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da rdfs:label ?dal . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcl)) = "collection" && LCASE(STR(?dal)) = "analysis") } GROUP BY ?year } } ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?year ?methodType (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?usages) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt . ?mt rdfs:label ?methodType . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodType)) != "no method") } GROUP BY ?year ?methodType ORDER BY ?year DESC(?usages)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?year ?totalPapers ?nonEmpiricalPapers ((xsd:decimal(?nonEmpiricalPapers) / xsd:decimal(?totalPapers)) AS ?proportionNonEmpirical) WHERE { { SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?totalPapers) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . } GROUP BY ?year } { SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper2) AS ?nonEmpiricalPapers) WHERE { ?paper2 orkgp:P31 ?c2 . ?c2 a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper2 orkgp:P29 ?year . ?c2 orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc rdfs:label ?dcl . ?c2 orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da rdfs:label ?dal . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcl)) = "no collection" || LCASE(STR(?dal)) = "no analysis") } GROUP BY ?year } } ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?paper ?methodType WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt . ?mt rdfs:label ?methodType . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodType)) != "no method") } ORDER BY ?paper

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?year ?empiricalTotal ?methodType ?papersUsingMethod ((xsd:decimal(?papersUsingMethod) / xsd:decimal(?empiricalTotal)) AS ?proportion) WHERE { { SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?empiricalTotal) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . ?c orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc rdfs:label ?dcl . ?c orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da rdfs:label ?dal . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcl)) = "collection" && LCASE(STR(?dal)) = "analysis") } GROUP BY ?year } { SELECT ?year ?methodType (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper2) AS ?papersUsingMethod) WHERE { ?paper2 orkgp:P31 ?c2 . ?c2 a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper2 orkgp:P29 ?year . ?c2 orkgp:P56008 ?dc2 . ?dc2 orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt . ?mt rdfs:label ?methodType . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodType)) IN ("experiment","secondary research","survey","case study","action research")) } GROUP BY ?year ?methodType } } ORDER BY ?year ?methodType

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?paper ?statisticalTest WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da orkgp:P56043 ?inferential . ?inferential orkgp:P35133 ?st . ?st rdfs:label ?statisticalTest . } ORDER BY ?paper

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?year ?statisticalTest (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?usages) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da orkgp:P56043 ?inferential . ?inferential orkgp:P35133 ?st . ?st rdfs:label ?statisticalTest . } GROUP BY ?year ?statisticalTest ORDER BY ?year DESC(?usages)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?totalPapers) (SUM(?reportedFlag) AS ?papersReportingThreats) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . ?contribution orkgp:P39099 ?t . OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P55034 ?a } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P55035 ?b } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P55036 ?c } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P55037 ?d } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P59109 ?e } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P60006 ?f } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P97002 ?g } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P68005 ?h } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P97000 ?i } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P97001 ?j } OPTIONAL { ?t orkgp:P145000 ?k } BIND(IF(xsd:integer(?a)=1 || xsd:integer(?b)=1 || xsd:integer(?c)=1 || xsd:integer(?d)=1 || xsd:integer(?e)=1 || xsd:integer(?f)=1 || xsd:integer(?g)=1 || xsd:integer(?h)=1 || xsd:integer(?i)=1 || xsd:integer(?j)=1 || xsd:integer(?k)=1, 1, 0) AS ?reportedFlag) } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?paper ?threatType WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?contribution orkgp:P39099 ?t . ?t ?threatPredicate ?flag . ?threatPredicate rdfs:label ?threatType . FILTER(?flag = true) } ORDER BY ?paper ?threatType

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?year ?empiricalTotal ?methodType ?papersUsingMethod ((xsd:decimal(?papersUsingMethod) / xsd:decimal(?empiricalTotal)) AS ?proportion) WHERE { { SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?empiricalTotal) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . ?c orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc rdfs:label ?dcl . ?c orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da rdfs:label ?dal . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?dcl)) = "collection" && LCASE(STR(?dal)) = "analysis") } GROUP BY ?year } { SELECT ?year ?methodType (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper2) AS ?papersUsingMethod) WHERE { ?paper2 orkgp:P31 ?c2 . ?c2 a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper2 orkgp:P29 ?year . ?c2 orkgp:P56008 ?dc2 . ?dc2 orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt . ?mt rdfs:label ?methodType . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodType)) IN ("case study","action research")) } GROUP BY ?year ?methodType } } ORDER BY ?year ?methodType

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?totalPapers) (SUM(?hasData) AS ?papersProvidingData) (SUM(?hasUrl) AS ?papersProvidingDataUrl) WHERE { { SELECT ?paper ?year (IF(BOUND(?d),1,0) AS ?hasData) (IF(BOUND(?u),1,0) AS ?hasUrl) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc orkgp:DATA ?d . OPTIONAL { ?d orkgp:url ?u } } } } } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?totalPapers) (SUM(?rqStatedFlag) AS ?papersWithResearchQuestion) (SUM(?rqHighlightedFlag) AS ?researchQuestionsHighlighted) (SUM(?rqHiddenFlag) AS ?researchQuestionsHidden) (SUM(?answerStatedFlag) AS ?papersWithAnswer) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P37330 ?rq . ?rq orkgp:P44139 ?qt . OPTIONAL { ?rq orkgp:P55039 ?hl } OPTIONAL { ?rq orkgp:P55038 ?hd } } OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P57004 ?rqa . } BIND(IF(BOUND(?qt) && LCASE(STR(?qt)) != "no question", 1, 0) AS ?rqStatedFlag) BIND(IF(BOUND(?hl) && xsd:integer(?hl) = 1, 1, 0) AS ?rqHighlightedFlag) BIND(IF(BOUND(?hd) && xsd:integer(?hd) = 1, 1, 0) AS ?rqHiddenFlag) BIND(IF(BOUND(?rqa), 1, 0) AS ?answerStatedFlag) } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?paper ?collectionMethodName ?analysisMethod WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?collectionMethod . ?collectionMethod orkgp:P94003 ?mt . ?mt rdfs:label ?methodType . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodType)) = "secondary research") OPTIONAL { ?collectionMethod orkgp:P145012 ?collectionMethodName } OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P15124 ?da . ?da orkgp:P1005 ?am . ?am rdfs:label ?analysisMethod } } ORDER BY ?paper

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?year ?totalPapers ?secondaryResearchPapers ((xsd:decimal(?secondaryResearchPapers) / xsd:decimal(?totalPapers)) AS ?proportionSecondaryResearch) WHERE { { SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?totalPapers) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?c . ?c a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper orkgp:P29 ?year . } GROUP BY ?year } { SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper2) AS ?secondaryResearchPapers) WHERE { ?paper2 orkgp:P31 ?c2 . ?c2 a orkgc:C27001 . ?paper2 orkgp:P29 ?year . ?c2 orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt . ?mt rdfs:label ?mtl . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?mtl)) = "secondary research") } GROUP BY ?year } } ORDER BY ?year

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?numberOfMethods (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?publications) WHERE { { SELECT ?paper (COUNT(DISTINCT ?methodType) AS ?numberOfMethods) WHERE { ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution . ?contribution a orkgc:C27001 . ?contribution orkgp:P56008 ?dc . ?dc orkgp:P1005 ?m . ?m orkgp:P94003 ?mt . ?mt rdfs:label ?methodType . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?methodType)) != "no method") } GROUP BY ?paper } } GROUP BY ?numberOfMethods ORDER BY ?numberOfMethods
